methods.name: setYaw
methods.description:
Sets the yaw of this location, measured in degrees.A yaw of 0 or 360 represents the positive z direction.A yaw of 180 represents the negative z direction.A yaw of 90 represents the negative x direction.A yaw of 270 represents the positive x direction.Increasing yaw values are the equivalent of turning to your
 right-facing, increasing the scale of the next respective axis, and
 decreasing the scale of the previous axis.

methods.name: getYaw
methods.description:
Gets the yaw of this location, measured in degrees.A yaw of 0 or 360 represents the positive z direction.A yaw of 180 represents the negative z direction.A yaw of 90 represents the negative x direction.A yaw of 270 represents the positive x direction.Increasing yaw values are the equivalent of turning to your
 right-facing, increasing the scale of the next respective axis, and
 decreasing the scale of the previous axis.

methods.name: setPitch
methods.description:
Sets the pitch of this location, measured in degrees.A pitch of 0 represents level forward facing.A pitch of 90 represents downward facing, or negative y
     direction.A pitch of -90 represents upward facing, or positive y direction.Increasing pitch values the equivalent of looking down.

methods.name: getPitch
methods.description:
Gets the pitch of this location, measured in degrees.A pitch of 0 represents level forward facing.A pitch of 90 represents downward facing, or negative y
     direction.A pitch of -90 represents upward facing, or positive y direction.Increasing pitch values the equivalent of looking down.

methods.name: length
methods.description:
Gets the magnitude of the location, defined as sqrt(x^2+y^2+z^2). The
 value of this method is not cached and uses a costly square-root
 function, so do not repeatedly call this method to get the location's
 magnitude. NaN will be returned if the inner result of the sqrt()
 function overflows, which will be caused if the length is too long. Not
 world-aware and orientation independent.

methods.name: lengthSquared
methods.description:
Gets the magnitude of the location squared. Not world-aware and
 orientation independent.

methods.name: distance
methods.description:
Get the distance between this location and another. The value of this
 method is not cached and uses a costly square-root function, so do not
 repeatedly call this method to get the location's magnitude. NaN will
 be returned if the inner result of the sqrt() function overflows, which
 will be caused if the distance is too long.

methods.name: distanceSquared
methods.description: Get the squared distance between this location and another.

methods.name: multiply
methods.description:
Performs scalar multiplication, multiplying all components with a

methods.name: simulateChestClosing
methods.description:
Simulates as if someone would close a container, such as an ender chest, normal chest or a shulker box.It'll play an animation and updates the redstone signal. Possibly even more is happening.There's an interal numerical counter that checks how many players have opened the chest.
     It's being used to determinate when the close animation needs to be played.
     Make sure to callsimulateChestOpening(World, int, int, int)equally as often as you called this method and not more or less, as otherwise it'll possibly break.
     The counter may even reach minus values.

methods.name: simulateChestOpening
methods.description:
Simulates as if someone would open a container, such as an ender chest, normal chest or a shulker box.It'll play an animation and updates the redstone signal. Possibly even more is happening.There's an interal numerical counter that checks how many players have opened the chest.
     It's being used to determinate when the close animation needs to be played.
     Make sure to callsimulateChestClosing(World, int, int, int)equally as often as you called this method and not more or less, as otherwise it'll possibly break.
     The counter may even reach minus values.

methods.description: Execute a task whose finish might not be instant.

methods.name: sync
methods.description: Synchronizes the upcoming chain with the main thread.

methods.name: syncLater
methods.description: Synchronizes the upcoming chain with the main thread after a certain amount of ticks.

methods.name: async
methods.description: Runs the upcoming chain in Bukkit's async thread-pool.

methods.name: asyncLater
methods.description: Runs the upcoming chain in Bukkit's async thread-pool after a certain amount of ticks.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Set the error handler for all the tasks in the chain.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Runs the chain of tasks.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Tries to cancel the chain of tasks.This will only cancel the execution of further tasks in the chain, and not the one that is already running.

methods.name: isRunning
methods.description: Checks if the chain is running right now.It isn't running if it either has been cancelled, has finished or never hasn't been run so far.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the chain.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Performs this operation on the given argument.

methods.name: andThen
methods.description:
Returns a composedThrowingConsumerthat performs, in sequence, this
 operation followed by theafteroperation. If performing either
 operation throws an exception, it is relayed to the caller of the
 composed operation.  If performing this operation throws an exception,
 theafteroperation will not be performed.

methods.name: LazyReference
methods.description: Creates a new lazy reference.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Gets the reference.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the cached reference.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new lazy reference.

methods.name: getBukkitPlayer
methods.description: Returns thePlayerthat is being wrapped.Returnsnullwhen the player is not on this server or when it's not a player.

methods.name: getCommandSender
methods.description: Returns theCommandSenderthat is being wrapped.Returnsnullwhen it is not being wrapped.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Remotes the name of the sender.For Bukkit Players:CommandSender.getName()For Remote Players:RemotePlayer.getName()For Console: Console

methods.name: getReference
methods.description: Returns the object that's being referenced. This may be aCommandSenderor aRemotePlayer.

methods.name: getRemotePlayer
methods.description: Returns theRemotePlayerthat is being wrapped.Returnsnullwhen the player is not on a remote server.

methods.name: getUniqueId
methods.description: Remotes the uuid of the sender. May benullif it's not supported for the type.For Bukkit Players:Entity.getUniqueId()For Remote Players:RemotePlayer.getUniqueId()

methods.name: hasPermission
methods.description: Returns whether the sender has a given permission.For Bukkit Players:Permissible.hasPermission(Permission)()} (Or whenhasOPis true: Always true)For Remote Players:Always true

methods.name: isBukkitPlayer
methods.description: Returns whether an online player executed this.If this method returnstrue, you may usegetBukkitPlayer().

methods.name: isConsole
methods.description: Returns whether it was the console that executed the command.

methods.name: isLocal
methods.description: Returns whether this object is wrapping a sender this is located on this server.

methods.name: isPlayer
methods.description: Returns whether it was a player who executed the command.

methods.name: isRemote
methods.description: Returns whether this object is wrapping a sender this is located on another server.

methods.name: isRemotePlayer
methods.description: Returns whether it's a player on a remote server.If this method returnstrue, you may usegetRemotePlayer().

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a single message that persists of the following components.For Bukkit Players:Player.Spigot.sendMessage(BaseComponent...)()}For Bukkit Misc (only text):CommandSender.sendMessage(String)()}For Remote Players:RemotePlayer.sendMessage(BaseComponent...)()}

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Constructs a new instance with a reference of the given player.

methods.name: wrapConsole
methods.description: Wraps the console of the given server.

methods.name: getAliases
methods.description:
Other possible names for accessing this command.Keep in mind that it's possible that aliases overlap themselves and there's no guarantee that this one will be executed if this occurs.
 Names of a command have a higher priority than aliases.These won't be shown in /bw help

methods.name: getFullName
methods.description: Returns the "full name" as if you'd type it in.E.g. it returns "/bw arena banana" where "bw" is the label which you pass in as a parameter.

methods.name: getHandler
methods.description: The handler handles what should happen when the command is e.g. getting executed

methods.name: getName
methods.description: The main name of the command, which will be displayed in e.g. /bw help.Example: If this returns "banana" then you'd have to type in /bw banana.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description:
A command must be added into a collection otherwise it's not accessible.As the system is built in a tree-structure-way each command must have a parent node/command.
 There's only one instance that doesn't have a parent and that's the root node which you obtain withBedwarsAPI.getRootCommandsCollection().

methods.name: getPermission
methods.description:
The permission needed to use the command.
 Sender will see an error if he does not have the permission and the execution won't be passed to the handler.nullmeans that no permission is needed to run the command

methods.name: getUsage
methods.description:
Returns the parameters the command expects for a specific sender.By default if no sender is being passed, the same usage that has been defined usingsetUsage(String).
   However, you may also add conditional usages by overridingCommandHandler.getContentAmount(CommandSender).

methods.name: hasContentAmount
methods.description: Returns whether or not it'll display the amount of entries in /bw [...] help.The amount is getting fetched by the current handler usingCommandHandler.getContentAmount(org.bukkit.command.CommandSender)

methods.name: isOnlyForPlayers
methods.description: Whether or not only players are able to execute the command

methods.name: isVisible
methods.description: Returns whether or not this command is visible in help.Interesting for debug or hidden commands which shouldn't be shown to normal players

methods.name: setAliases
methods.description:
Set the new aliases of the command. You don't have to include the name of the command in the array.Keep in mind that it's possible that aliases overlap themselves and there's no guarantee that this one will be executed if this occurs.
 Names of a command have a higher priority than aliases.These won't be shown in /bw help
